name: Ganesh Infraworld Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Ganesh Infraworld Limited is a construction company providing construction-related services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Ganesh Infraworld Limited specializes in integrated engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services across diverse infrastructure domains.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 177 to 79.3 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 36.5 days to 75.6 days
